name: android_pinch_gesture
description: Executes a two-finger pinch gesture (zoom in / zoom out) centered at specified normalized or pixel coordinates.

scale.description: Scale factor (> 1.0 to zoom in, e.g. 1.5; < 1.0 to zoom out, e.g. 0.5). Alias: scaleFactor.

scaleFactor.description: Alias for scale (> 1.0 to zoom in, < 1.0 to zoom out).
